For each fixed model pair, record per-user hit differences d=h_A−h_B ∈ {−1,0,1}, using identical users and 99 fixed negatives. Estimate Δ=(1/4)Σ_c mean(d_c). A practical paired, category-stratified bootstrap resamples 200 users with replacement within each category, preserving each user’s paired outcomes; recompute Δ over 10,000 replicates and report a 95% percentile interval plus category differences and discordant-hit counts. This applies the [paired-bootstrap principle](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html). One additional hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.00125. Intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained models and fixed candidates; they exclude training randomness and negative-sampling variability. Sampled rankings can disagree with full-catalog rankings, so conclusions must remain specific to the pinned sampled benchmark ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Repeatedly selecting configurations or checkpoints on these same validation users creates selection optimism; an ordinary bootstrap interval around the eventual winner does not correct that adaptive search ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Without independent confirmation, report validation gains as exploratory, disclose all trials/checkpoints inspected, and avoid claiming unbiased generalization. Prespecified comparisons can use multiplicity adjustment, but this does not erase unrestricted adaptive reuse.

Suggested compute strategy: preregister a small set of single-change ablations, identical seeds, evaluation checkpoints and promotion rules; screen at equal training budgets, then promote promising candidates to the full budget using successive-halving principles ([Hyperband](https://jmlr.org/papers/v18/16-558.html)). Keep all four categories at every stage, retain baseline comparisons, reserve budget for full-length confirmation, and count failures and diagnostics toward 43,200 GPU-seconds. Bootstrap cached outcomes on CPU; leave splits, evaluator, candidates and test labels untouched.
